summary: V1 pre-deployment re-verification after backend logger-init reorder. Backend pytest suite (7/7) passed and full frontend enquiry flow passed end-to-end. Enquiry POST + GET persistence, empty-form validation, invalid-email 422, success block copy, 'Send another' reset, all three 'Start a Conversation' CTAs smooth-scrolling to #contact, footer mailto, and both shadcn Selects working. Venture CTAs open in new tab with correct external URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger initialization is now correctly moved to top of module before route definitions — earlier latent NameError risk is resolved.
server.py: @app.on_event('shutdown') is still deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to a lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Contact.jsx: axios.post has no explicit timeout; a hanging network call will keep the submit button stuck in 'Sending...' indefinitely. Recommend adding a 15s timeout.

EnquiryCreate model: interested_in and organisation_type accept any free-text (only max_length). If the intent is to constrain to the listed dropdown options, use Literal/Enum on the Pydantic model (currently a divergence between UI options and API contract).
backend .env: CORS_ORIGINS is '*' — acceptable for preview, recommend restricting for production deployment.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (removed hardcoded default URL — now reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL strictly from env)
seed_data_creation: Created 6 TEST_-prefixed enquiries in `enquiries` collection across this iteration (TEST_Alice x2, TEST_Bob, TEST_NoEmail attempt rejected, TEST_BadEmail rejected, TEST_EmptyMsg rejected, TEST_Playwright User). Safe to leave; clearly namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py green. All 13 review-request items verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. shadcn Select option testid pattern: `${selectTestId}-option-<slug>` (slug lowercased with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-'). Backend GET /api/enquiries returns records sorted by submitted_at desc and correctly excludes Mongo _id.
rca of the issue: No issues found in this iteration. The prior latent-logger concern flagged in iteration_1 has been fixed by the main agent. App is ready for V1 deployment from a functional standpoint.
